levels.surface: عبد الله بن ثعلبة بن صعير

notes: Two branches joined by «ح», each with its own names and the same saying (Zakat al-Fitr): two groups, no shared tail; the passage after «ثم اتفقا» is the matn.
«- هو ابن وائل -» and «قال محمد بن يحيى هو بكر بن وائل بن داود» are glosses identifying Bakr; left out, Bakr kept as written.
«أو قال عبد الله بن ثعلبة» gives the transmitter's alternative name for the Companion of branch A; it is noted, not written as a second route.
«عن أبيه» is a bare relation with no name written.
